svg.title: hangar_sim TF tree: the odom-to-world bridge beside the rejected hardware tree shape
svg.desc: Two transform trees side by side. On the left, the shape in the tree today: map to odom published live by beluga_amcl, then a static odom to world bridge, then world, which is MoveIt's planning root and carries the hangar's 66 collision meshes on fixed joints, and below world the base's three real joints down to ridgeback_base_link and the arm. The localization estimate sits above world, so the environment never moves. On the right, the rejected shape: map to odom to base_link with no bridge, the base pose read from drifting wheel odometry, and the hangar left attached above that drifting edge, so the aircraft and boxes move relative to the base while TF stays self-consistent.

svg.text: The hangar is welded to the same root the base joints hang off, so the bridge is a tree-shape workaround — it holds the environment still, it does not correct the estimate.
